report.title: Session 800 — Agent N: Metadata Completeness Audit

architecture.overview: Three distinct JSON object architectures across the 5 packs. All are structurally parseable as arrays of objects.

pack_A.description: Each QID = exactly one JSON object containing ALL fields. Content fields (Part, Section, Topic, Difficulty, Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect) precede metadata fields (QuestionID, question_state, ExplanationWrongA-D, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel) within the same object.
key_characteristics: QuestionID appears once per item (near end of object)
CorrectChoice after Choices in the same object
No split between metadata block and content block

pack_B.description: Each QID = two JSON objects. Block 1 (metadata): ExplanationWrongA-D, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel, VerifiedChecks. Block 2 (content): Part, Section, Topic, Difficulty, Stem, ExplanationCorrect, QuestionID, question_state, Choices, CorrectChoice, StudyLinks, VerifiedChecks, ExplanationWrongA-D (duplicate).
key_characteristics: CorrectChoice BEFORE QuestionID in content block (unique to Pack B — all other packs have CC after QID or in same object)
ExplanationWrongA-D appears in BOTH blocks (explains why field count is still 500, not 1000 — only one block's fields are readable by grep in a given scope)
QuestionID and question_state in Block 2 (content block), not Block 1
Block 2 has no DiffcultyScore or CognitiveLevel — those are only in Block 1

pack_C.description: Each QID = two JSON objects. Block 1 (metadata): QuestionID, question_state, certification_date, certification_batch, ExplanationWrongA-D, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel, VerifiedChecks. Block 2 (content): Part, Section, Topic, Difficulty, Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, StudyLinks, LOSTag, UniqueConceptKey.
key_characteristics: QuestionID in Block 1 (metadata block) — standard for Packs C/D but different from Pack B
CorrectChoice follows Choices in Block 2 — standard
Difficulty only in Block 2 (content block)

pack_D.type: dual-object per QID (metadata-first + content) — 2 items have structural defects
pack_D.description: Same layout as Pack C: Block 1 (metadata) with QuestionID, question_state, ExplanationWrongA-D, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel. Block 2 (content) with Part, Section, Topic, Difficulty, Stem, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, LOSTag, UniqueConceptKey.
key_characteristics: 2 items (P1-FD-045, P1-FD-075) have ONLY a metadata block — their content blocks are MISSING
P1-FD-045: metadata block at lines 23693-23709, next object is P1-FD-046's content block (no FD-045 content)
P1-FD-075: metadata block at lines 25164-25180, array closes at line 25181 (no FD-075 content block)
Both missing items are Section F, question_state: Unprocessed

pack_E.type: dual-object per QID (content-first + metadata) — reversed order
pack_E.description: Each QID = two JSON objects in REVERSED order from Packs C/D. Block 1 (content-first): StudyLinks, SourceDescription, Section, Difficulty, Topic, UniqueConceptKey, CorrectChoice, Choices. Block 2 (metadata): LOSTag, VerifiedChecks, Stem, ExplanationCorrect, QuestionID, ExplanationWrongA-D, question_state, DifficultyScore, CognitiveLevel.
key_characteristics: QuestionID in Block 2 (metadata), not Block 1
Difficulty in Block 1 (content-first)
Stem + ExplanationCorrect in Block 2 alongside QuestionID — unique to Pack E
No content fields (Section, Topic, Choices, etc.) in Block 2
CONTENT before METADATA (reversed from C/D)
10 extra Difficulty matches beyond 500 items (510 total) — likely from edge-case duplication

field_coverage.note: Coverage % = (field_matches / 500_items) × 100. Fields with >100% indicate extra matches from pack headers, duplicated fields, or non-item objects.

pack_A.note: +3 extra matches — likely from pack-level header object or edge-case items

pack_D.note: 2 items lack content blocks (no Difficulty field). Actual count of 499 suggests one of these items has Difficulty elsewhere — investigation deferred.

pack_E.note: +10 extra matches — all are valid Difficulty enum values; likely from field duplication in edge-case items

pack_state.note: pack_state field is NOT used in any pack. All governance is at the question_state level.

Subtopic.note: Subtopic field is NOT used in any pack. Topic serves as the granular concept identifier. MicroTopic is present instead.

pack_D.note: Section F has 74 instead of 75 — P1-FD-045 or P1-FD-075 lacks Section field

pedagogical_cluster.note: pedagogical_cluster is almost entirely unused. Only 8 items across all 2,500 (0.32%) have this field set.

difficulty_enum_validity.overview: All Difficulty values across all packs are valid Caqs taxonomy values. No 'Very Difficult' (5) items in any pack.

pack_A.note: 3 extra matches included in these counts

difficulty_score_validity.overview: All DifficultyScore values are integers 1-4. Valid range is 1-5 per CaQS. No value outside this range detected. No score of 5 in any pack.
difficulty_score_validity.validation: ALL VALUES VALID (1-4 range, all integers, no NaN, no null, no string)

cognitive_level_validity.overview: All CognitiveLevel values match the CaQS taxonomy: Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate. No invalid values detected.
cognitive_level_validity.pack_E_anomaly: Pack E has 394 Understand vs only 94 Apply (inverse of other packs). This is a dramatic calibration difference suggesting Pack E uses a different labeling philosophy.

question_state_analysis.note: Packs B and E are 100% Certified. Pack A is 96.2% Certified. Packs C and D are 70% Certified each. 319 items remain Unprocessed (94+93=187) or Archived (56+57+19=132). No items in In Audit or Editorial Queue — no active review pipeline items.

explanation_wrong_empty_slot_analysis.overview: Empty ExplanationWrong slots correspond approximately to CorrectChoice distribution (~25% per letter). Higher empty-slot counts in Packs C/D (238 each for slot A) suggest a CorrectChoice bias toward A in those packs.
explanation_wrong_empty_slot_analysis.interpretation: Higher empty-slot count = more items where that letter is CorrectChoice. Pack C/D have ~238/500 EW-A empty → ~47.6% of items have CC=A in those packs.

structural_defects_found.description: Two items have metadata blocks but MISSING content blocks. Fields missing from these items: Difficulty, LOSTag, Topic, Section, Choices, CorrectChoice, ExplanationCorrect, UniqueConceptKey. Both items are section F, question_state: Unprocessed.
structural_defects_found.learner_impact: None — both items are Unprocessed (not in delivery pool). But they block certification and cause pack-level field-count inconsistencies.

structural_defects_found.description: 3 extra Difficulty field matches beyond the 500 items. Likely from pack-level header object or an item with duplicated Difficulty field. No missing items detected — all 500 items have Difficulty. The 3 extras inflate the count to 503.

10 extra Difficulty field matches beyond the 500 items. All 10 extra values are valid Difficulty enum strings. Likely from edge-case items with Difficulty in both content and metadata blocks, or from non-item objects.

field_absence_findings.description: The pack_state field is specified in QUESTION_METADATA_STANDARD.md §9.1 but is not present in any item. All governance tracking uses question_state instead. This is consistent — no functional gap.
field_absence_findings.recommendation: Either remove pack_state from the metadata standard or populate it during a future metadata enrichment pass.

field_absence_findings.description: The Subtopic field (optional per metadata standard) is not used anywhere. Items use Topic + MicroTopic instead.
field_absence_findings.recommendation: No action required — Subtopic is optional. Topic + MicroTopic serve the same purpose.

field_absence_findings.description: Almost entirely unused. Only 7 items in Pack A and 1 item in Pack E have this field. This field was designed for axis-varying question sets but was never systematically populated.
field_absence_findings.recommendation: Populate during future metadata enrichment if axis-varying questions are important for the AI Performance Review Engine. Otherwise, document as deprecated.

within_pack_consistency.pack_A: CONSISTENT — all 500 items follow the same single-object layout with identical field sets. No section-level variation.
within_pack_consistency.pack_B: CONSISTENT — all 500 items follow the same dual-object layout. However, Pack B's CorrectChoice-before-QuestionID ordering is UNIQUE among all packs and has caused scan false positives (see DL-029).
within_pack_consistency.pack_C: CONSISTENT — all 500 items follow the same dual-object layout with identical field sets per block.
within_pack_consistency.pack_D: PARTIALLY INCONSISTENT — 498 items follow the standard dual-object layout. 2 items (P1-FD-045, P1-FD-075) have only a metadata block with no content block.
within_pack_consistency.pack_E: CONSISTENT — all 500 items follow the same dual-object layout with reversed block ordering. No section-level variation.

schema_consistency.cross_pack_consistency: INCONSISTENT — Three distinct architectures across 5 packs. This creates maintenance burden: scan scripts, validators, and remediation tools must handle multiple object layouts. See architecture section for details.

delivery_pool_summary.note: The 2 structurally incomplete items (P1-FD-045, P1-FD-075) are Unprocessed, not in the delivery pool. No learner impact.

key_gaps_and_risks: 1. Pack D has 2 items with missing content blocks (P1-FD-045, P1-FD-075) — blocks certification. Must be either repaired (content authored) or archived.
2. Cross-pack architecture inconsistency (3 different object layouts) creates ongoing scan-tool maintenance burden. Standardizing to a single layout would reduce future defect risks.
3. pedagogical_cluster is 99.68% absent — the field exists in the standard but was never systematically populated. If needed for AI Performance Review, a population pass is required.
4. Pack E's CognitiveLevel distribution (78.8% Understand, 18.8% Apply) is inverted from all other packs. This suggests a calibration philosophy difference, not a data defect.
5. No items have DifficultyScore=5 (Very Difficult) — the top end of the difficulty scale is unused across all 2,500 items.
6. Packs C and D have 47.6% of items with CorrectChoice=A (based on EW-A empty-slot count), suggesting answer-key position bias.
recommendations: 1. Repair P1-FD-045 and P1-FD-075 (Pack D Section F) by authoring missing content blocks or archiving them.
2. Standardize pack architectures in a future refactoring sprint to eliminate the 3-layout maintenance burden.
3. Run a CorrectChoice position-balance audit for Packs C/D (suspected A-bias from empty-slot distribution).
4. Evaluate Pack E's CognitiveLevel calibration against CAQS §6.2 targets (Apply should be ~40% but Pack E is at 18.8%).
5. Consider populating pedagogical_cluster during a future metadata enrichment pass if axis-varying session composition is a priority.
6. Document the absence of DifficultyScore=5 across all packs — either add Very Difficult items or adjust CAQS §6.1 targets.

limitations: Field presence counted by regex match on field name strings — does not verify that the field belongs to the correct JSON sub-object
Empty vs non-empty ExplanationWrong analysis is approximate (uses regex pattern matching, not JSON parser)
CorrectChoice position distribution inferred from EW-slot empty rates, not directly tabulated
Pedagogical cluster QID assignment verified via context-line inspection for Pack A (7 items confirmed), Pack E inferred
The 3 extra Pack A Difficulty matches and 10 extra Pack E Difficulty matches were NOT individually traced to source — noted as artifacts
